article_title_id: Tips Sukses Tambak Udang Vaname Hasil Melimpah: Panduan 12 Langkah Berbasis SNI
article_title_en: Practical Tips for Successful Vannamei Shrimp Pond Operations: A 12-Step SNI-Aligned Playbook

images.concept: Intensive vannamei shrimp pond at golden hour with paddlewheel aerators spinning and white foam trails across dark green brackish water, tropical Indonesian coastal setting
images.prompt: Photorealistic wide-angle photograph of an intensive vannamei shrimp (Litopenaeus vannamei) pond in tropical coastal Indonesia at golden hour, warm orange-amber sunlight raking low across the water surface from the horizon, four to six large paddlewheel aerators (kincir air) actively spinning and throwing white foam arcs across a dark olive-green brackish pond surface, rectangular pond with earthen berm walls and a thin plastic pond liner visible at the water edge, tall tropical grasses and low coconut palms silhouetted on the berm in the background, humid haze of coastal Java or Sulawesi, sky gradient from deep orange near horizon to soft purple-blue above, reflections of the kincir foam trails shimmering on the pond surface, photojournalism composition with slight lens flare from low sun, 16:9 landscape aspect ratio, shallow depth of field on midground kincir, no workers visible, no text overlays, no watermarks, no logos, no anatomical errors, no garbage, no dead animals, no branded equipment.
images.alt_id: Tambak udang vaname intensif dengan kincir aerator berputar di permukaan air payau saat sore hari, pesisir tropis Indonesia
images.alt_en: Intensive vannamei shrimp pond with paddlewheel aerators spinning across a dark-green brackish surface at golden hour, Indonesian coastal setting
images.caption_id: Tambak udang vaname intensif beroperasi dengan kincir air (kincir aerator) untuk menjaga kadar oksigen terlarut di atas 4 ppm — salah satu variabel yang paling menentukan keberhasilan siklus budidaya 100–120 hari.
images.caption_en: An intensive vannamei pond running paddlewheel aerators to maintain dissolved oxygen above 4 ppm — one of the most decisive variables in a 100-to-120-day production cycle.
images.fallback_note: FLUX handles outdoor tropical agricultural photography well. If the kincir foam-trail detail renders poorly or the water color reads as ocean rather than brackish pond, re-prompt with 'murky dark-green shallow brackish coastal aquaculture pond, NOT ocean or clear water'. Otherwise a Shutterstock search for 'tambak udang intensif kincir' (e.g., Shutterstock contributor 'wildlife_art' or 'MRAORAOR') yields good authentic results.

images.prompt: Clean modern illustrated infographic on white background showing the four sequential phases of intensive vannamei shrimp production as a left-to-right horizontal timeline with four equal-width cards connected by arrows, card 1 labeled with a bracket placeholder [PERSIAPAN] showing a simple flat icon of a dry empty rectangular pond with a lime-powder bag icon and a shovel, card 2 labeled [PENEBARAN BENUR] showing a small shrimp larvae silhouette icon inside a water droplet and a calendar icon indicating days 1-7, card 3 labeled [GROW-OUT] showing a feed pellet icon alongside a spinning paddlewheel aerator icon and a small adult shrimp silhouette, card 4 labeled [PANEN] showing a harvest net scoop icon and a weighing scale icon, soft aquaculture color palette of teal, seafoam green, and sandy beige on white background, sans-serif typography, each card has 2-3 short bullet-line placeholder brackets below the icon, no specific text values written (use [LABEL] brackets only), 16:9 aspect ratio, educational infographic style, no logos, no watermarks, no text beyond bracketed placeholders.
images.alt_id: Infografis empat fase siklus budidaya udang vaname: Persiapan, Penebaran Benur, Grow-out, dan Panen dalam alur horizontal
images.alt_en: Horizontal infographic showing the four phases of the vannamei production cycle: Preparation, Stocking, Grow-out, and Harvest
images.caption_id: Siklus budidaya vaname intensif terbagi dalam empat fase utama — setiap fase memiliki checklist teknis tersendiri yang menentukan keberhasilan fase berikutnya, dari pengeringan dasar kolam hingga panen parsial.
images.caption_en: The intensive vannamei production cycle breaks into four phases, each with its own technical checklist — from pond dry-out in preparation through partial-harvest strategy at day 70 to 80.
images.fallback_note: FLUX handles clean flat-icon infographics at medium quality well provided text is kept out of the image itself (bracket placeholders are used). If the arrow flow between cards is unclear, try the OpenAI fallback (-Generator openai) which is stronger at structured layout infographics. Alternatively, this is a strong candidate for an in-house Canva or Adobe Illustrator build using the four-card structure described — a designer can produce it in 30 minutes using the phase labels from the article.

images.concept: Water quality monitoring dashboard with 4 gauge dials (pH, temperature, salinity, DO) showing optimal green zones — dark professional UI aesthetic
images.prompt: Clean scientific monitoring dashboard illustration on dark navy-blue background showing four circular gauge dial instruments arranged in a 2x2 grid, each dial has a thin arc scale with a clearly marked green optimal zone arc and pointer needle, dial 1 shows a thermometer icon labeled with a bracket placeholder [SUHU] with the green zone occupying roughly the middle third of the arc, dial 2 shows a water-drop salinity icon labeled [SALINITAS] with the green zone in the mid-range, dial 3 shows a pH symbol icon labeled [pH] with green zone in the alkaline-neutral range, dial 4 shows a bubble oxygen icon labeled [DO] with the green zone in the upper portion of the arc, each dial has a small legend strip below it showing a green bar for optimal zone but no specific numbers written, dark navy and deep teal background with subtle grid lines, clean flat-design instrument aesthetic similar to a scientific field meter interface, soft glow effect around each green zone arc, aquaculture monitoring mood, 16:9 landscape aspect ratio, no logos, no watermarks, no text beyond [BRACKET PLACEHOLDER] labels.
images.alt_id: Dashboard monitoring kualitas air tambak vaname dengan empat indikator gauge: suhu, salinitas, pH, dan oksigen terlarut (DO)
images.alt_en: Water quality monitoring dashboard for vannamei shrimp ponds with four gauge dials: temperature, salinity, pH, and dissolved oxygen (DO)
images.caption_id: Empat parameter kualitas air yang paling kritis di tambak vaname — suhu (28–32°C), salinitas (15–25 ppt optimal), pH (7,8–8,7), dan DO (≥4 ppm) — harus dipantau 2–3 kali sehari di sistem intensif sesuai standar SNI 01-7246-2006.
images.caption_en: The four most critical water-quality parameters in a vannamei pond — temperature (28–32°C), salinity (15–25 ppt optimal), pH (7.8–8.7), and dissolved oxygen (≥4 ppm) — require monitoring two to three times daily in intensive systems per SNI 01-7246-2006.
images.fallback_note: FLUX handles dark-UI dashboard illustrations reliably at medium quality when no specific numeric text is required. The bracket-placeholder approach keeps text out of the image. If the gauge needle positions render ambiguously or the green zone arcs are not distinct, try increasing quality to 'high' on re-run, or use the OpenAI generator which handles structured UI mock-ups better. A Figma or Canva template for scientific gauges is also a fast fallback for editorial use.
